name: hud_ui_widget_hit_test
description: HudUiWidget::HitTest rejects hidden widgets, obtains bounds through ftable slot 11, and tests inclusive x/y containment against the returned HudUiRect.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4b4030 yet; tier S remains open for a later HudUiWidget/source-file table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4b4030 validates rejecting flags bit 0x10, dispatching ftable slot 11 for bounds, returning false for null bounds, and inclusive left/right/top/bottom coordinate checks.
The native smoke verifies in-bounds and out-of-bounds points, null-bounds miss behavior, hidden widgets avoiding the bounds dispatch, and HudUiWidget_FTable slot 23 registration.
